summary: Iteration 83 - MAARS Command Rebrand Verification Complete. All rebrand requirements verified: 'MAARS ∞' replaced with 'MAARS Command', indigo/violet color scheme confirmed, watermark positioned bottom-right, dashboard shows only Commander Orion, Agents page hover-expand popup working on both cards and gallery views.

landing_page_branding.details: Navbar shows 'MAARS Command' with MAARS logo. Footer shows 'MAARS Command by MAARS Global Corporation'. Buttons use indigo/violet gradient.

login_page_branding.details: Left panel shows MAARS logo + 'MAARS Command'. Sign In button uses indigo/violet gradient. Footer shows 'MAARS Command by MAARS Global Corporation'.

login_functionality.details: Login with management.maars@marsgc.net / Admin123! works correctly, redirects to dashboard.

sidebar_branding.details: Sidebar shows prominent MAARS logo with 'MAARS Command' title and 'by MAARS Global Corporation' subtitle.

sidebar_credits.details: Credits display (5483.00) with 'Business' plan badge and '+ Buy Credits' button. Uses indigo/violet colors.

dashboard_command_center.details: Dashboard shows 'Command Center' heading with stats grid (Total Chats, Total Tasks, Completed, Active Agents).

dashboard_commander_only.details: Dashboard shows 'Your Commander' section with Commander Orion card only. No 'Specialized Agents' or 'All Agents' sections.

dashboard_commander_card.details: Commander card shows name ('Commander Orion'), role ('Commander'), description, capabilities (Task Delegation, Strategic Planning, Team Orchestration, Multi-Agent Coordination), and Chat button.

dashboard_quick_actions.details: Quick Actions present: New Chat, Create Task, Browse Agents, Create Agent. All use indigo/violet color scheme.

watermark_position.details: Watermark fixed at bottom-right (not center) showing MAARS logo + 'MAARS COMMAND' + 'by MAARS Global Corporation'.

agents_page_view_toggle.details: View toggle (cards/gallery buttons) working correctly. Can switch between views.

agents_cards_view_hover.details: Cards view shows compact agent cards. Hover-expand popup shows portrait, role, name, capabilities, description, tools count.

agents_gallery_view_hover.details: Gallery view shows compact 8-column grid. Hover-expand popup shows same details as cards view (portrait, role, name, capabilities, description).

color_scheme_indigo_violet.details: Color scheme verified as indigo/violet throughout: credits section, buttons, gradients, accents. No blue/cyan remnants visible.

no_maars_infinity_text.details: No 'MAARS ∞' text found in visible UI on landing page, login page, dashboard, or agents page. Rebrand complete.

Agents.jsx: Both cards and gallery views have hover-expand popup with same structure showing portrait, role, name, capabilities, description
index.css: CSS variables use indigo/violet palette (--primary: 239 84% 67%, --accent: 263 70% 58%)
